'''Bloodskin''' was a [[Flesh Raider]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Bloodskin and other Flesh Raiders were organized into an [[Flesh Raider army|army]] by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]] around [[3643 BBY]]. Bloodskin was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a Republic-affiliated individual at some point during the [[Flesh Raider uprising|conflict]] between the Flesh Raiders and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==Behind the scenes==
Bloodskin appears in the [[BioWare]]&ndash;[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an Elite boss on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Tython. Bloodskin is not directly involved in any quests, however they can be killed by any Republic-affiliated character as part of the achievement "Liberator of Tython". This articles assumes 100% game completion, which means Bloodskin was killed.
